fr_html: Le PRESIDENT, sur une remarque de Mr. Root, propose de viser dans deux alinéas séparés, les travaux de La Haye, et les documents et projets particuliers.
en_html: The PRESIDENT, following a remark made by Mr. Root, proposed that the works undertaken at the Hague, and private documents and schemes, should be dealt with in separate paragraphs.
